How did Lakhbir Singh Lakha create some of the most popular devotional songs, including “Pyara Saja Hai Tera Dwar Bhawani” and “Maiya Ka Chola Hai Rang Lal”? What are the stories behind these iconic bhajans?
In this promo for The Lallantop’s Guest In The Newsroom, singer Lakhbir Singh Lakha sits down with Kuldeep Mishra to share fascinating stories from his musical journey, the making of his famous bhajans, and his experiences in the music industry.
From Gulshan Kumar and Daler Mehndi to Sidhu Moose Wala and the demand for Khalistan, Lakha opens up about a range of intriguing subjects.
